lines.text: …I was walking home from the convenience store. I saw him under the bridge. That’s all. Can I go home now?
What did you hear before midnight?

…There was a sound. Earlier. Before midnight — around ten to eleven. A little bell, ringing under the bridge. Then someone with a dark umbrella walked away along the river. I hid in the bus shelter. I didn’t go down until midnight.
AI unavailable (network down (test)). Using scripted reply.

…I knew him. He gave me maths lessons at his house, for free. My school doesn’t allow it. I had a lesson tonight, but he cancelled. Here — “Sorry, Yuki. Cancel tonight. Someone from the old days wants to talk.” It felt wrong. So I went to check.
